definitions: A long strip or loop of cloth worn over one shoulder or around the waist, especially as part of a uniform or for ceremonial purposes.
A frame holding the glass in a window or door, especially one that slides up and down to open.
A band of material, typically silk or satin, worn around the waist or over the shoulder as a decorative accessory or part of a uniform.
examples: She wore a silk sash over her dress.
